sloka: ततो ऽश्वमेधः सुमहान्महेन्द्रस्य महात्मनः ।ववृधे ब्रह्महत्ययाः पावनार्थं नरेश्वर ।। ७.८६.९ ॥
transliteration: tato 'śvamedhaḥ sumahānmahendrasya mahātmanaḥ ।vavṛdhe brahmahatyayāḥ pāvanārthaṁ nareśvara ।। 7.86.9 ॥

translations.english: O king of men, then the very great Ashwamedha sacrifice of the great-souled Mahendra prospered for the purification from the sin of Brahmanicide.
